name: Thornwick Border Guard

bonuses.4: Hold the Line grants nearby mercenaries +6 Armor

lore: Standard kit issued to the twelve-year border veterans who held the Redwater fords long after the capital stopped sending pay-wagons.

name: Caldera Siege-Breaker

bonuses.4: Melee criticals sunder 6 Armor and trigger a shockwave

lore: Hammered over open volcanic cracks in Ironcamp by Forgemaster Vok for the vanguard tasked with cracking the Gauntlet of Iron.

name: Greywood Fen-Stalker

bonuses.4: First shot from cover deals +50% Crit Damage and roots 2s

lore: Worn by border poachers and Redmarsh toll-marksmen who learned that unseen boots live three winters longer than loud armor.

name: Harborwall Windlass Corps

bonuses.3: +20% Ranged Attack Speed and +20% Cold Resistance
bonuses.4: Every third bolt pierces in a line for 140% weapon damage

lore: Tailored for Gate Warden Lyra's coastal pickets who held Oakhaven's sea-walls against armored privateers with windlass bolts and roof-slates.

name: Collegium Thermodynamicist

bonuses.4: Casting a fire spell empowers your next lightning spell by +35%

lore: Assembled by expelled mint-assayers who proved that imperial state liturgy was merely poorly documented thermal engineering.

name: Celestial Spire Magister

bonuses.3: -20% Spell Mana Costs and +15% Cast Speed
bonuses.4: 20% chance for any spell cast to trigger a free Astral Nova

lore: Relic vestments preserved in Oakhaven's sealed vaults, woven to channel raw ley-currents without scorching the bearer's knuckles.

name: Lower-Parish Probate Clerk

bonuses.2: +25% Raised Servant HP and +1 Max Servant
bonuses.3: +18% Curse & DoT Damage and +1.5 Mana Regen/s
bonuses.4: Slain cursed foes rise automatically as indentured skeletons

lore: Kept by Thornwick's mortuary clerks who discovered that delinquent tax liens remain legally enforceable long after the debtor's funeral.

name: Coastal Abbey Oath-Keeper

bonuses.2: +25% Healing & Shield Power and +20% Mind Resistance
bonuses.4: Forgive the Oath restores 30% Mana and grants 3s Invulnerability

lore: Vestments of the coastal scriptorium arbiters who bound unquiet sailors' ghosts to honor deathbed promises before releasing them to rest.

name: Redmarsh Salt-Caravan Guard

bonuses.2: +20% Poison & Fire Resistance and +10% Movement Speed
bonuses.4: Potions heal +40% more and cleanse poison and bleed

lore: Practical gear pieced together by Quartermaster Bram's outriders who survived the alkali flats by valuing clean water above heraldry.

name: First Watch Threshold Remnant

bonuses.4: Summons an elite First Watch Bailiff whenever a boss phase shifts

lore: Salvaged from the obsidian steps below the Threshold Chamber, still warm with the unfulfilled oaths of Thornvael's original wardens.
